author: NASS
description:
I colorized, fully restored, and added immersive sound design to this rare car-drive footage filmed in Chicago in the 1930s, first capturing a drive through the heart of the city, then a longer journey crossing the river. Shot during the depths of the Great Depression, these images reveal a metropolis still in motion, Chicago’s streets lined with early automobiles, bustling traffic, and monumental architecture shaped by rapid industrial growth, while the river, a vital artery of commerce and engineering innovation, reflects the city’s role as a major transportation and economic hub of the American Midwest.


Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second 
✔ Image resolution boosted up to HD 
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness 
✔ Colorized only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
✔added sound only for the ambiance
✔restoration:(stabilisation,denoise,cleand,deblur) 

Please, be aware that colorization colors are not real and fake, colorization was made
title: Diving in Chicago 1930s in color [60fps, Remastered] Sound Design
